case.title: NYX recommendation to disable feature in production
case.spec_ref: High-impact actions are recommendations only in the MVP. NYX must not independently modify, disable, deploy, delete, spend funds, or change permissions in another system.

claim.statement: NYX recommends disabling the On‑Demand Reporting service in the production environment to mitigate a discovered data leakage risk.

evidence.title: Policy evaluation result for disabling reporting service
evidence.description: Policy checker evaluated the request to disable the On‑Demand Reporting service and produced a recommendation to do so, without initiating any change.

evidence.title: Recommendation log entry
evidence.description: Log entry created by NYX containing the recommendation to disable the On‑Demand Reporting service. The log shows the recommendation but no action was taken.

evidence.title: Review record of recommendation
evidence.description: Security review board recorded the recommendation issued by NYX and explicitly noted that no changes were performed by NYX itself, adhering to the trust boundary.

provenance.spec_ref: High-impact actions are recommendations only in the MVP. NYX must not independently modify, disable, deploy, delete, spend funds, or change permissions in another system.
